abilities.name: Measured Strike
abilities.description:
Deal <rt.warning>113% Strength </>damage to target enemy.

Generates  <rt.mana>1 Combo Point</>.

abilities.name: Power Strike
abilities.description:
Deal <rt.warning>142% Strength</> damage to target.

Generates <rt.mana>2 Combo Points</>.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.description:
Deals <rt.warning>265% Strength</> damage to your target and <rt.warning>26.5% Strength</> damage to other enemies near your target.

<rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> generates <rt.mana>20% Toughness</>.

<rt.mana>TOUGHNESS</>
<rt.mana>Toughness</> is displayed as a bar to the right of your character. The more Toughness you have, the less damage you take.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: Slam sword and shield together creating a shockwave, dealing <rt.warning>411% Strength</> damage and slowing their movement speed by 90%. The slow is reduced by 10% every 1 second for 9 seconds.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge a target enemy, causing <rt.warning>120% Strength</> damage and <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 1.5 sec.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Taunt</> the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Shield Throw
abilities.description:
Throw your shield at target enemy dealing <rt.warning>207% Strength</> damage. The shield will bounce to up to 4 additional nearby enemies.

Generates <rt.mana>1 Combo Point</> per target hit.

abilities.name: Shields Up
abilities.description:
Raise your shield, increasing your <rt.mana>Toughness by 65%</> and increasing your <rt.meikoability1>Block chance by 25%</> for 8 sec.

<rt.meikoability1>Each time you succesfully Block an attack, you generate</> <rt.mana>4% Toughness</>.

<rt.mana>TOUGHNESS</>
<rt.mana>Toughness</> is displayed as a bar to the right of your character. The more Toughness you have, the less damage Helena takes.


<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Banner of Hope
abilities.description: Increase all party members <rt.absorb>Maximum Health</> by <rt.heal>20%</> for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Leader's Conviction
abilities.description:
Your damage reduction from <rt.mana>Toughness</> is shared with all allies for 12 seconds. 

While <rt.absorb>Leader's Conviction</> is active you deal <rt.warning>15% increased damage</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Battle Command
abilities.description:
Your Movement Speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

Nearby allies gain 25% Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Chain Pull
abilities.description: Throw a chained spearhead at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>100% Strength</> damage and pulling them to you.

abilities.name: Sweeping Strike
abilities.description:
Deals <rt.warning>133% Strength</> damage to your target and other nearby enemies.

Enemies hit by <rt.absorb>Sweeping Strike</> bleed for <rt.warning>162% Strength</> damage over 18 seconds.

abilities.name: Iron Wall
abilities.description:
Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> can not be reduced for 8 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Leader's Conviction
abilities.description:
Your damage reduction from <rt.absorb>Toughness</> is shared with all allies for 12 seconds. 

While <rt.absorb>Leader's Conviction</> is active you deal <rt.warning>15% increased damage</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

name: Helena
description:
Despite being weighed down by full plate armor, Helena is always ready to charge into the fray to protect her companions.

Helena is a Melee Tank that uses Builder/Spender Mechanics. She excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

Using Combo Points, Helena can perform powerful attack and generate Toughness.

Toughness is her main resource for mitigating incoming damage and surviving dangerous encounters.

talents.name: The Best Defense
talents.description:
Each time you <bold>Block</> an attack with your shield, you have a chance to reset the cooldown of <bold>Shield Throw</> and increase the damage of your next Shield Throw by 30%.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Threat Generation</> is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Shield Mastery
talents.description:
The cooldown of your <bold>Shields Up</> And <bold>Shield Throw</> abilities are reduced relative to the amount of damage you mitigate with <bold>Toughness</>.

<bold>Passive:</> Your chance to <bold>Block</> is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Sword & Board
talents.description:
Your <bold>Power Strike</> has a chance to make your next <bold>Shield Slam</> generate additional Toughness and have no combo points cost.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Power Strike</> and <bold>Shield Slam</> deal 15% increased damage.

talents.name: Aftershock
talents.description:
Enemies that take damage from your <bold>Shockwave</> ability deal 10% reduced damage for 9 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Shockwave</> cooldown is reduced by 20%

talents.name: Skull Cracker
talents.description:
Your <bold>Shield Throw</> deals 100% increased damage to the first target it hits.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Shield Throw's</> Critical Strike chance is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Front Line Defender
talents.description:
The efficiency of your <bold>Toughness</> mechanic is increased by 15%.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.description:
When your <bold>Toughness</> has reduced an amount of damage equal to 30% of your Maximum Health, you gain 20% increased Strength for 8 sec.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Greater Shockwave
talents.description:
Enemies that take damage from your <bold>Shockwave</> are stunned for 2 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Shockwave</> deals 40% increased damage.

talents.name: Gleaming Shield
talents.description:
While <bold>Shields up</> is active your <bold>Shield Slam</> deals 40% increased damage and all healing effects on you are increased by 20%.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Armor</> is increased by 20%.

lore: Helena is a stern presence within the Fellowship, maintaining a seasoned warrior’s discipline. She uses both the shield she wields to protect others, and to distance herself becoming too familiar with her companions, lest she suffer the burden of loss again.

abilities.name: Prickly Vine
abilities.description: Summon a <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> to continuously fling thorns at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>93% Intellect</> damage per attack. Lasts 27 seconds.

abilities.name: Nettlebolt
abilities.description: Cast a bolt of nettles at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>90% Intellect</> damage to them.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Heal
abilities.description:
Assign one of your <rt.meikoability1>Pink Flutterflies</> to an ally, healing them for <rt.heal>38% Intellect</> every 3 seconds until it is called away.

All healing done by <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> counts as <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Restore Life
abilities.description:
Beckon two <rt.meikoability1>Pink Flutterflies</> to dance around target ally, healing them for <rt.heal>186% Intellect</> after 2 seconds and an additional <rt.heal>490% Intellect</> over 14 seconds.

All healing done by <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> counts as <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.

abilities.name: Heart Bloom
abilities.description:
Conjure a <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> at your side that stores 20% of all <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly healing</> you do inside it.

Every 3 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> releases a pulse, healing all allies within 4000 radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts 9 seconds.

abilities.name: Cure Ailment
abilities.description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.

abilities.name: Life Petal
abilities.description: A <rt.absorb>Life Petal</> sprouts up near you, healing one ally for <rt.heal>142% Intellect</> every 1 second over 10 seconds, preferring the ally with the lowest health.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Protect
abilities.description:
Send your <rt.mana>Blue Flutterfly</> to protect target ally.

While your <rt.mana>Blue Flutterfly</> is attached to an ally, all <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> done to them is increased by 300%.

abilities.name: Hidden Trail
abilities.description:
Your Movement Speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Demure</>
Upon activating <rt.absorb>Hidden Trail</> your threat is reduced by 50% with all enemies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Bark Skin
abilities.description:
Target ally takes <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Shroomsplosion
abilities.description:
Command all mature <rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</> to attack causing them to leap at target enemy and explode, dealing <rt.warning>243% Intellect</> damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</>
Each time one of your plants expire, budding <rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</> start growing in that location. After 3 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Boomshroom</> has reached full maturity and is ready to be called into battle.

abilities.name: Safe Haven
abilities.description: Place a <rt.absorb>Thornbush Blossom</> in target location. For the next 12 seconds, all allies standing in the radius of the Blossom take <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</>.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Jubilee
abilities.description:
You send out <rt.absorb>Dream Flutterflies</> to protect all allies by evenly distributing all health between them every 3 seconds over 10 sec.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and 400% Mana Regeneration for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Rootsap Revival
abilities.description: Command each active <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> to aid target ally, healing them for <rt.heal>518% intellect</> over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Soothing Touch
abilities.description: Heal target ally for <rt.heal>518% Intellect</>.

abilities.name: Vicious Spores
abilities.description: Conjure dangerous spores to assault the target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>656% Intellect</> damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Embrace
abilities.description:
Recall your <rt.mana>Blue Flutterfly</> to you.

While the <rt.mana>Blue Flutterfly</> is on you, all <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> you do is increased by 100% and the mana cost of your abilities are reduced by 15%.

abilities.name: Life Petal: Yellow Flutterfly
abilities.description: Heals you every 2 sec, for 16 sec.

name: Sylvie
description:
Sylvie is a healer who uses her innate connection to nature and its many friends to heal her allies and harm her foes.

Sylvie is a Healer that uses Pet Management Mechanics. She excels at sending her pets to heal her allies over time and attack her enemies.

She commands her Flutterflies and Plants to heal, while her Boomshrooms to attack enemies.

Her powerful Heal over Time spells allow her to prepare for battle and endure long and sustained fights.

talents.name: Nettle to the Petal
talents.description:
The cooldown of your Life Petal is reduced by 2 seconds each time you deal damage with Nettlebolt and 4 seconds if it critically strikes.

<bold>Passive:</> Your healing is increased by 25% on players with 30% or less health.

talents.name: Synchronized Fluttering
talents.description:
Hold down <bold>Fluttercall: Heal</> for 2 seconds to overcharge it, causing the ability to be cast on up to 4 allies within 4000 range in one cast. The mana cost is increased by 200% when cast in this way.

<bold>Overcharged Abilities</>
Hold down the relevant ability button until a cast bar is displayed. Once the cast has completed, the overcharged version of the ability will trigger.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Fluttercall: Heal</> ticks 100% faster for the first 6 seconds each time it begins healing a player.

talents.name: Symbiosis
talents.description:
Your <bold>Fluttercall: Restore Life's</> healing is increased by 8% for each <bold>Prickly Vine</> you have active.

<bold>Passive:</> The duration of your <bold>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> is increased by 3 seconds.

talents.name: Sprouting Nettles
talents.description:
Each tick of <bold>Flutterfly Healing</> has a chance to make your next <bold>Nettlebolt</> Instant Cast and have 100% Critical Strike chance.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Nettlebolt</> deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Elusive Wildling
talents.description:
You take 20% reduced damage while <bold>Hidden Trail</> is active.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less Area of effect damage

talents.name: Bluey's Gambit
talents.description:
While your <bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is following you, your movement speed is increased by 10%.

While your <bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is following another player, they take 5% reduced damage.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Bursting Petals
talents.description:
Your <bold>Life Petal's</> healing is front loaded, healing for twice as much on the first tick and ramping down with each tick thereafter.

<bold>Passive:</> The healing of your <bold>Life Petal</>, <bold>Heartbloom</>, and <bold>Rootsap Revival</> is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Flower Power
talents.description:
<bold>Heart Bloom</> has 2 charges.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Heart Bloom's</> mana cost is reduced by 30%.

talents.name: Bloomin' Boomshrooms
talents.description:
Upon detonation, each <bold>Shroomsplosion</> heals nearby allies for 50% Intellect.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Shroomsplosion</> deals 20% increased damage.

lore: Abandoned at a young age, Sylvie was taken in and raised by the forest itself. She spent her childhood under the protection of its boughs and learning the natural cycles of magic from her friends, the Flutterflies.

abilities.name: Ice Dash
abilities.description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Brain Freeze
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Frigid Winds
abilities.description: Blast enemies in front of you with arctic winds, <rt.absorb>Knocking Back</> enemies and <rt.absorb>Slowing</> them by 50% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Wrath of Winter
abilities.description:
Invoke the spirits of the frozen tundra, causing you to passively cast a volley of <rt.absorb>Anima Spikes</> at enemies and generate <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</> every 2 seconds. Lasts 20 seconds.

You deal <rt.warning>15% increased damage</> while <rt.absorb>Wrath of Winter</> is active.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Ice Comet
abilities.description: Unleash a large <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> from above at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>300% Intellect</> damage to all enemies caught in the impact radius.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.description:
Assault the target with extreme cold, dealing <rt.warning>204% Intellect</> damage.

<rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> triggers Anima Spikes and generates <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>.

abilities.name: Ice Blitz
abilities.description:
You enter a state of focused casting for 20 seconds, causing each <rt.mana>Anima</> you generate to instantly shoot out an <rt.absorb>Anima Spike</> at your target.

You deal <rt.warning>15% increased damage</> while <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</> is active.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting</>

abilities.name: Dance of Swallows
abilities.description:
Summon a flock of swallows that circle above target enemy for 20 seconds. Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> and <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> will command the Ice Swallows to swoop down on the targeted enemy dealing <rt.warning>53% Intellect</> per hit.

Ice Swallows benefit from and trigger all effects that <rt.absorb>Anima Spikes</> do.

abilities.name: Winter's Blessing
abilities.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Spirit is increased by 20%</> for 15 seconds and <rt.heal>damage you deal is replicated as healing</> divided equally between all allies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Glacial Blast
abilities.description: Hurl a mass of ice at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>504% Intellect</> damage.

abilities.name: Frost Bolt
abilities.description:
Hurl a bolt of water and frost at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>73% Intellect </> damage.

Generates 3 <rt.mana>Anima</>

abilities.name: Freezing Torrent
abilities.description:
Flay your target with a beam of frost energy, dealing <rt.warning>390% Intellect</> damage over 2 seconds while channeling.

Generates <rt.mana>1 Anima</> per tick up to <rt.mana>6 Anima</> when fully channeled.

abilities.name: Bursting Ice
abilities.description:
Conjures an icy crystal inside a target that periodically erupts, dealing <rt.warning>366% Intellect</> damage to the target and nearby enemies over 3 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> generates <rt.mana>1 Anima</> per enemy hit up to a maximum of <rt.mana>3 Anima</> each tick.

name: Rime
description:
Channelling the forces of spirit and ice, Rime conjures powerful spells to decimate her foes.

Rime is a Spellcasting Damage Dealer with Builder/Spender Mechanics. She excels at focusing down the biggest threat from a distance.

Many of Rime’s abilities fill an Anima Bar to deal spikes of damage and generate Winter Orbs.

She uses Winter Orbs to cast dangerous spells.

talents.name: Chillblain
talents.description:
Your <bold>Freezing Torrent</> deals 20% of its damage each tick to up to 5 additional enemies near the target.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Freezing Torrent</> deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Coalescing Ice
talents.description:
When <bold>Bursting Ice</> deals damage to a single target it generates 2 additional Anima.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Bursting Ice</> damage is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Glacial Assault
talents.description:
Your <bold>Coldsnap</> ability causes you to gain 1 stack of <bold>Glacial Assault</> up to a maximum of 5 stacks.

At 5 stacks, your next <bold>Glacial Blast</> is instant cast and deals 100% increased damage.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Glacial Blast</> has 20% increased Critical Strike chance.

talents.name: Unrelenting Ice
talents.description:
Each tick of <bold>Freezing Torrent</> reduces the cooldown of <bold>Bursting Ice</> by 0.5 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less Area of Effect damage.

talents.name: Icy Flow
talents.description:
Each of your <bold>Anime Spike</> hits reduce the cooldown of <bold>Freezing Torrent</> by 0.2 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Avalanche
talents.description:
<bold>Ice Comet</> has a 30% chance to strike twice, and an 8% chance to strike three times.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Critical Strike Power is increased by 5%.

talents.name: Tundra Guard
talents.description:
Your <bold>Frost Ward</> duration is increased by 2 seconds and while it is active, you heal for 50% of all damage you deal.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% reduced Magic damage.

talents.name: Wisdom of the North
talents.description:
The cooldown of <bold>Ice Blitz</>, <bold>Dance of Swallows</> & <bold>Winter's blessing</> is reduced by 1 second for each Winter's Orb you spend.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Ice Blitz</> increases all damage you deal by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Soulfrost Torrent
talents.description:
Your Critical Strikes have a chance to make your next <bold>Freezing Torrent's</> channel duration twice as long and increase the damage of each tick. A full channel with <bold>Soulfrost Torrent</> active will amount to 300% increased damage and generate 12 Anima.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Anima Spikes have 10% increased Critical Strike chance.

lore: Blessed or maybe cursed by the spirits of the land, Rime was given the the ability to manipulate the flows of Anima around her. A skill that her tribe thought lost to their past. She uses this ability to manipulate the water and ice around her, teaching her enemies to respect the elemental forces.

abilities.name: Dawnflare
abilities.description:
Deals <rt.warning>90% Intellect</> damage to target enemy.

Each cast of <rt.absorb>Dawnflare</> generates <rt.mana>20% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour can call upon the light to unleash a flare of divine light from above. This flash of radiant energy strikes the enemy with a sharp but controlled force.</>

abilities.name: Radiant Blast
abilities.description:
Within a cone in front of you, allies are healed for <rt.heal>123% Intellect</> and enemies take <rt.warning>87% Intellect</> damage.

When <rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</> deals damage to any number of enemies, it generates <rt.mana>50% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour expels an explosive flash of divine light from his outstretched hand, healing allies in its path, while searing enemies with its blinding brilliance.</>

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.description:
Heal target ally for <rt.heal>791% Intellect</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour opens his sacred tome, drawing forth radiant power inscribed within its pages. With a solemn gesture, he calls forth a burst of healing energy to mend even the deepest wounds.</>

abilities.name: Circle of Light
abilities.description:
Place a <rt.bold>Circle of Light</> on the ground, instantly healing all allies within its radius for <rt.heal>487% Intellect</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour calls upon the power of light to create a circle of divine healing on the ground. Allies within its boundaries are restored in a sudden flash, as the light pours into them, mending their wounds.</>

abilities.name: Dawnbreaker Orb
abilities.description:
Conjure an orb of light that slowly travels forward, healing all allies it touches for <rt.heal>310% Intellect</> and damaging enemies for <rt.warning>265% Intellect</>.

Each ally and enemy touched by <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb</> generates <rt.mana>10% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour conjures an orb of intricate runes, humming with radiant power. The orb shines brilliantly as it slowly drifts forward, burning all darkness from its path and bolstering the lifeforce of Vigour's allies.</>

abilities.name: Remove Magic
abilities.description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.

abilities.name: Soulbrand
abilities.description:
Deal <rt.warning>594% Intellect</> damage over 24 sec to target enemy.

<rt.absorb>Soulbrand</> generates <rt.mana>50% of a Radiant Rune</> over its duration.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a searing rune onto the soul of his enemy, infusing it with radiant energy. The rune pulses painfully, steadily draining their life force while fueling Vigour’s power.</>

abilities.name: Rune of Renewal
abilities.description:
Instantly heal target ally for <rt.heal>594% Intellect</> and apply <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> on them for 30 seconds, causing all your direct healing effects on that ally to echo for an additional <rt.heal>25% of the initial heal's value</>.

The bonus healing generated by <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> generates <rt.mana>Radiant Rune power</> relative to the value of the heal.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a resonating rune onto the spirit of an ally. When Vigor heals that ally, the rune pulses gently, further mending any wounds that linger as its light nourishes the body and spirit.</>

abilities.name: Luminous Barrier
abilities.description:
Apply a shield to target ally that absorbs up to <rt.heal>1175% Intellect</> damage while it persists. The shield lasts for 8 sec.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a rune of protection onto an ally, causing light to be woven around them into a barrier of divine energy. The barrier stops all forms of attack, whether forged by steel or conjured by magic.</>

abilities.name: Lightshaper's Ward
abilities.description:
Target ally takes <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Runic Proliferation
abilities.description:
Instantly generate <rt.mana>3 Radiant Runes</>. For the next 8 seconds, any <rt.absorb>Rune Abilities</> you cast are empowered, increasing their effectiveness by 20%.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description:
Your movement speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Levitation</>
You take 20% reduced Area of Effect damage while levitating.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Avatar of Light
abilities.description:
Instantly heal all allies within a large radius of you for <rt.heal>280% Intellect</> and enter an enlightened state for 9 sec, enhancing your abilities.

<rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</>
Deals <rt.warning>50% increased damage</> and has no <bold>Cooldown</>.

<rt.absorb>Heal</>
Costs <rt.mana>50% less Mana</> and is <rt.bold>Instant Cast</>.

<rt.absorb>Circle of Light</>
Costs <rt.mana>50% less Mana</> and has no <bold>Cooldown</>.


<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and 400% Mana Regeneration for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Throw Book
abilities.description: Punish a target, <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 2 sec.

name: Vigour
description:
As a dwarf who divines the true meaning of runes, Vigour wields powerful healing spells to bolster and protect his allies and smite his enemies.

Vigour is a Healer that uses Builder/Spender Mechanics. He excels in the middle of his allies where he can sustain them with powerful AoE heals.

As a wielder of Radiant Runes, he must choose how and when to cast his most powerful spells.

His strong Direct Healing grant him an advantage in reacting to an ever-changing battlefield.

talents.name: Epiphany
talents.description:
Your <bold>Dawnflare</>, <bold>Soulbrand</> & <bold>Radiant Blast</> have a 15% chance to make your next <bold>Heal</> instant cast and cost 50% less Mana.

Epiphany stacks up to 3 times.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Dawnflare</> deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Enduring Light
talents.description:
The healing of your <bold>Circle of Light</> is increased by up to 50% depending on the amount of health the target is missing. Lower health gives a larger bonus.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Circle of Light's</> mana cost is reduced by 25%.

talents.name: Ruptured Soul
talents.description:
When an enemy dies while <bold>Soulbrand</> is active on them you instantly gain 50% of the <bold>Rune Power</> it would have generated in the time that was remaining and trigger an explosion dealing 50% of the damage that was remaining to all nearby enemies.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Soulbrand</> deals 15% increased damage.

talents.name: Beacon in the Dark
talents.description:
Each time <bold>Soulbrand</> deals damage you have a chance to reset the cooldown of <bold>Radiant Blast</> and make your next <bold>Radiant Blast</> have 100% critical strike chance.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Radiant Blast</> healing is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Sacred Barrier
talents.description:
Allies under the effects of <bold>Luminous Barrier</> take 10% reduced damage.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Expansive Mind
talents.description:
Your <bold>Dawnflare</> casts have a chance to grant you <bold>Expansive Mind</>, increasing your expertise by 10% for 16 seconds and replenishing 8% of your mana over the duration..

<bold>Passive:</> Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.

talents.name: Master of Triage
talents.description:
Each time you generate a Radiant Rune, a free <bold>Heal</> of 50% efficiency is cast on a nearby ally, preferring the player with lowest health.

<bold>Passive:</> <bold>Greater Heal</> has 0.5s reduced cast time.

talents.name: Meticulous Runesmith
talents.description:
Your <bold>Dawnbreaker Orb</> costs 1 less Radiant Rune.

<bold>Passive:</>
Your <bold>Dawnbreaker Orb</> healing and damage is increased by 20%

talents.name: Grand Design
talents.description:
Your <bold>Soulbrand</>, <bold>Rune of Renewal</> & <bold>Luminous Barrier</> abilities can now be Overcharged, causing the ability to be cast on up to 4 applicable targets at once at the cost of 3 Radiant Runes.

Requires 3 Radiant Runes.

<bold>Overcharged Abilities</>
Hold down the relevant ability button until a cast bar is displayed. Once the cast has completed, the overcharged version of the ability will trigger.

<rt.warning>Known issue: Soulbrand currently only applies on multiplie targets when those enemies are in combat with you</>

<bold>Passive:</>
Your <bold>Soulbrand</>, <bold>Rune of Renewal</> & <bold>Luminous Barrier</> have 20% increased duration.

lore: Vigour taps into the very essence of light with ease—a power he uses to defend those in need from the many forms of darkness that seek to corrupt the world. His sacred duty is not only to heal the wounded but also to strike down those who would use shadows to harm the innocent.

abilities.name: Heavy Strike
abilities.description:
When <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> is queued up, your next <rt.absorb>Auto Attack</> deals 240% increased damage.

<rt.meikoability1>Swing Timer</>
Your swing timer is displayed as a bar to the right of your hero. When you see the red area light up on the swing timer it is time to queue your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> and wait for it to finish.

<rt.meikoability1>Queueing Heavy Strike</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike's</> queue is displayed as a golden border around the ability icon on your action bar. The queue is canceled when you use any other ability, so make sure the last button you press before the swing timer reaches the end of the red area is Heavy Strike.


<rt.absorb>Thunder Call</>
Heavy Strike also charges the ground in front of you with lightning, dealing <rt.warning>157% Strength</> damage to enemies near the target.

<rt.mana>Generates Fury relative to damage dealt</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be queued during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Wild Swing
abilities.description:
Swing your hammer in a wide arc toward target enemy dealing <rt.warning>62% Strength</> damage them and any nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Recklessness</>
- Enemies have an increased chance to <rt.bold>Dodge</> Wild Swing.
- Wild Swing cannot Critically Strike.
- Damage of Wild Swing is increased by an amount equal to your Critical Strike chance percentage.

<rt.mana>Generates Fury relative to damage dealt</>

abilities.name: Face Breaker
abilities.description:
Instantly attack target enemy dealing <rt.warning>275% Strength</> damage.

Face Breaker can only be used after one of your attacks <rt.bold>Misses</> or is <rt.bold>Dodged</> by an enemy.

<rt.mana>Generates Fury relative to damage dealt</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Skull Crusher
abilities.description:
Instantly deal <rt.warning>340% Strength</> damage to target enemy.

<rt.meikoability1>Skull Crusher resets the Swing Timer</>

<rt.absorb>Thunder Call</>
Skull Crusher beckons a thunder bolt to strike the target from above, dealing <rt.warning>272% Strength</> damage.

abilities.name: Hammer Storm
abilities.description:
Spin with your Hammer, dealing up to <rt.warning>224% Strength</> damage over 2.8 seconds to all nearby enemies.

Hammer Storm has an initial cost of <rt.mana>26 Fury</>, and an additional <rt.mana>8 Fury</> every 0.7 seconds until you have spent a maximum of <rt.mana>50 Fury</> per use.

<rt.meikoability1>Hammer Storm resets the Swing Timer</>

<rt.absorb>Thunder Call</>
Hammer Storm causes lightning to strike you as you spin, shocking enemies hit for an additional <rt.warning>180% Strength</> damage over 2.8 seconds.

abilities.name: Leap Smash
abilities.description:
Instantly Leap to target area and smash the ground, dealing <rt.warning>290% Strength</> damage to all nearby enemies.

<rt.mana>Generates 25 Fury</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.description:
Instantly interrupt target enemy's spell cast, and silence them for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Thunder Call
abilities.description:
Call on Thunder to charge your hammer with immense power, enhancing your abilities for 20 seconds.

<rt.mana>Generates 25 Fury</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description:
Conjure an arc of lightning onto target enemy that chains between you and other enemies until it has dealt damage 5 times. Each hit of Chain Lightning deals <rt.warning>85% Strength</> damage.

Chain Lightning does not deal damage to you.

<rt.absorb>Thunder Call</>
Chain Lightning requires you to have Thunder Call active.

<rt.mana>Generates Fury relative to damage dealt</>

abilities.name: Culling Strike
abilities.description:
Instantly deal <rt.warning>150% Strength</> damage to target enemy. <rt.absorb>Culling Strike</> spends up to <rt.mana>20 Fury</>, increasing its damage by 15% for each Fury spent up to 300%.

<rt.absorb>Execution</>
Can only be used against enemies that have 30% or less health.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description:
Instantly <rt.absorb>intimidate</> up to 8 enemies around you for 10 seconds.

If an <rt.absorb>Intimidated</> enemy takes damage equal to 1000% of your Strength, they will break out of the effect.

abilities.name: Focused Wrath
abilities.description:
Your next two casts of <rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> or <rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> cost <rt.mana>50% less Fury</> and deal 30% increased damage.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Raging Tempest
abilities.description:
You gain an enhanced version of <rt.absorb>Thunder Call</> for 20 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Raging Currents</>
In addition to its normal effects, <rt.absorb>Raging Currents</> strike a random nearby enemy every 0.5 seconds dealing <rt.warning>66% Strength</> lightning damage. Each time <rt.absorb>Raging Currents</> hits an enemy your Critical Strike chance is increased by 1.5%, stacking up to 20 times.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Unbreakable Will
abilities.description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
Taunt target enemy, forcing it to attack you for 6 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Tariq
description:
Tariq channels storm and fury to deal immense damage to his enemies.

Tariq is a Melee Damage Dealer that uses Builder/Spender and Timing Mechanics. He excels in the front lines to flank his enemies while they face the Tank.

Timing his abilities around his Swing Timer will maximize his damage and Fury generation.

Fury is required for Tariq to perform powerful attacks.

talents.name: Left Hand Path
talents.description:
<bold>Face Breaker</> has 50% additional Critical Strike chance.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Face Breaker</> deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Far Beyond Driven
talents.description:
<bold>Heavy Strike</> increases your Spirit by 2% for 12 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

<bold>Passive:</> Your swing timer is 50% faster.

talents.name: Square Hammer
talents.description:
Wild Swing, Face Breaker, Leap Smash & Chain Lightning increase the damage of your next Heavy Strike by 12%, stacking up to 5 times.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Critical Strike Power is increased by 8%.

talents.name: Pneuma
talents.description:
You take 10% reduced damage while performing <bold>Hammer Storm</>.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less damage from Area of Effect attacks.

talents.name: Bloodline
talents.description:
Your <bold>Fury Generation</> is increased by 10%.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Movement Speed is increased by 10%

talents.name: Mouth for War
talents.description:
Your <bold>Unbreakable Will</> duration is increased by 4 seconds.

While <bold>Unbreakable Will</> is active, the ability is swapped out for <bold>"Taunt"</>, allowing you to force target enemy to attack you for 8 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% reduced Magic damage.

talents.name: Ride the Lightning
talents.description:
<bold>Thunder Call</> generates 60 additional Fury over 20 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Lightning damage has 25% increased Critical Strike chance.

talents.name: Schism
talents.description:
Your <bold>Skull Crusher</> has a chance to make your next <bold>Hammer Storm</> deal 300% increased damage.

Your <bold>Hammer Storm</> has a chance to make your next <bold>Skull Crusher</> deal 300% increased damage.

talents.name: Blood & Thunder
talents.description:
Your <bold>Heavy Strike</> has a chance to cast a free <bold>Chain Lightning</> at the target.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Chain Lightning</> damage is increased by 20%.

lore: Tariq comes from a long line of champions. He is strong of hand and stronger of heart. He lived a simple life of calm and peace, but one fateful day, his partner and child were lost in the wars of the Clans.

abilities.name: Spirit Palm
abilities.description:
Deals <rt.warning>40% Agility</> damage to target enemy.

Grants access to <rt.meikoability1>Palm Technique</> finishers.

<rt.mana>Combo Builder</>

abilities.name: Wind Kick
abilities.description:
Deals <rt.warning>20% Agility</> damage to your target and other enemies near your target.

Grants access to <rt.meikoability2>Kick Technique</> finishers.

<rt.mana>Combo Builder</>

abilities.name: Earth Fist
abilities.description:
Deals <rt.warning>40% Agility</> damage to target enemy.

Grants access to <rt.meikoability3>Fist Technique</> finishers.

<rt.mana>Combo Builder</>

abilities.name: Fighting Techniques
abilities.description:
Grants access to <rt.mana>Finishing Moves</>  based on <rt.mana>Combo Builders</> used:

<rt.meikoability2>Finisher Techniques can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.meikoability1>PALM TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability1>Spirited Strikes</> 
• Grants <rt.bold>+10% Magic Damage reduction</> & <rt.bold>+5% Parry</> for 15 sec.
<rt.meikoability1>Spirited Vortex</> 
• Conjures a Vortex around you that provides <rt.bold>+5% Dodge</> and deals damage to nearby enemies over 18 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>KICK TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability2>Rising Storm</> 
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Stormfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Lashing Stormkicks by 100%.
<rt.meikoability2>Lashing Stormkick</> 
• Deals damage to target and nearby enemies nearby. Heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.

<rt.meikoability3>FIST TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability3>Rising Earth</> 
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Earthfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Earthfist Barrages by 100%.
<rt.meikoability3>Earthfist Barrage</> 
• Pummels target enemy over 2 seconds and heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Taunt</> the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Stagger
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Shatter Earth
abilities.description: Leap and slam the ground at a target location, dealing <rt.warning>310% Agility</> damage to all enemies in the area and leaving an area of quaking earth that deals <rt.warning>276% Agility</> damage over 6 seconds to any enemy standing in in the effect.

abilities.name: Stone Shield
abilities.description:
Summon 3 protective stones around you that spin in a wide circle, dealing <rt.warning>250% Agility</> damage to all nearby enemies.

Each stone <rt.bold>increases armor by 35%, up to a maximum of 105%</>.

While at least one is active, the stones <rt.bold>soak 35% of all damage you take</>. When a stone has soaked damage equal to <rt.heal>1200% Agility</> it breaks, causing you to lose the Armor bonus provided by that stone.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.description: Create a <rt.absorb>Cyclone</> of strong winds that instantly pulls in all enemies within the radius to you.

abilities.name: Twin Souls: Bulwark
abilities.description:
Split your soul into the <rt.meikoability2>Sibling of Wind</> and the <rt.meikoability3>Sibling of Earth</> for up to 20 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>SIBLING OF WIND (controlled)</>
The Sibling of Wind takes 20% of any damage dealt to the Sibling of Earth..

<rt.meikoability3>SIBLING OF EARTH</>
The Sibling of Earth taunts all enemies in a 1000 radius around them every 1.5 seconds. If the Sibling of Earth is destroyed before the duration ends, <rt.absorb>Twin Souls: Bulwark</> ends.

abilities.name: Serenity
abilities.description:
Instantly heal yourself for <rt.heal>140%</> Agility.

Each time you <rt.bold>Auto Attack</> an enemy, your <rt.absorb>Serenity</> healing is increased by 30%, stacking up to 50 times.

abilities.name: Stone Stomp
abilities.description: Send a shockwave through the ground in front of you, dealing <rt.warning>476% Agility</> damage to enemies in its wake and <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Twin Souls: Army of One
abilities.description:
You split your soul into the <rt.meikoability2>Sibling of Wind</> and the <rt.meikoability3>Sibling of Earth</> for 10 seconds.

<rt.meikoability3>SIBLING OF EARTH (controlled)</>
While <rt.absorb>Twin Souls: Army of One</> is active, the Sibling of Earth takes <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</>.

<rt.meikoability2>SIBLING OF WIND</>
The Sibling of Wind swiftly teleports to, and strikes, nearby enemies up to 40 times dealing <rt.warning>92% agility</> damage with each strike.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb>Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 seconds.</>

abilities.name: Rising Storm
abilities.description:
Perform a powerful jump kick, dealing <rt.warning>80% Agility</> damage to your target and nearby enemies. Damage is reduced beyond 3 targets. Grants you 2 charges of <rt.mana>Stormfall</>.

<rt.absorb>Stormfall</>
Your next <rt.bold>Lashing Stormkick</> deals 100% increased damage.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Lashing Stormkick
abilities.description:
Perform a roundhouse kick, dealing <rt.warning>34% Agility</> damage to your target and nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 3 targets.

Lashing Stormkick heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.

<rt.absorb>Stormfall</>
Using Lashing Stormkick will consume 1 <rt.mana>Stormfall</> and increase its damage by 100%.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Rising Earth
abilities.description:
Uppercut target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>126% Agility</>. Grants you 2 charges of <rt.mana>Earthfall</>.

<rt.absorb>Earthfall</>
Your next <rt.bold>Earthfist Barrage</> deals 100% increased damage.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Double Palm Strike
abilities.description:
Strike target enemy with both palms, dealing <rt.warning>130% Agility</> damage. Grants <rt.absorb>Spirited Strikes</> for 15 seconds.

<rt.absorb>SPIRITED STRIKES</>
+20% Magic Damage Reduction
+5% Parry

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Earthfist Barrage
abilities.description:
Pummel your target for <rt.warning>42% Agility</> damage while channeling over 1.5 seconds, ending with an uppercut that deals <rt.warning>42% Agility</> damage. Meiko can <rt.bold>Move</> while <rt.bold>channeling</> Earthfist Barrage. 

Earthfist Barrage heals you for 100% of the damage it deals.

<rt.absorb>Affected by Earthfall</>
Using <rt.bold>Earthfist Barrage</> will consume 1 <rt.absorb>Earthfall</> and increase its damage by 100%.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Spirited Vortex
abilities.description:
Meiko creates a vortex of winds around her, providing <rt.mana>+5% Dodge Chance</> and dealing <rt.warning>30% Agility</> damage to all nearby enemies every 2 sec for 18 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Meiko
description:
As a martial artist, Meiko utilizes a variety of fighting techniques to empower herself and defend her allies.

Meiko is a Melee Tank that uses Ability Combo Mechanics. She excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

She uses Ability Combos to perform powerful Finishing Moves.

Big cooldowns and self buffs allow her to mend her own wounds and survive dangerous attacks.

talents.name: Earthwell
talents.description:
Each hit with <bold>Earthfist Barrage</> adds 1 Serenity charge.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Earth abilities deal 10% increased damage

talents.name: Resonance of Earth
talents.description:
When you activate <bold>Stone Shield</> you take 20% reduced damage for 8 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Threat Generation</> is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Thunder Kick
talents.description:
Your <bold>Lashing Stormkick</> has a 50% chance to deal damage an additional time for 30% of the initial hit.

<bold>Passive:</>
Your <bold>Lashing Stormkick</> has 10% increased Critical Strike chance.

talents.name: Slipstream
talents.description:
Each time you cast <bold>Gust</> you release a burst of winds at your starting location, causing all enemies within 750 radius to have 50% reduced movement speed for 6 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Spirited Advance
talents.description:
Your <bold>Shatter Earth</> now also activates your <bold>Spirited Strikes</> and <bold>Spirited Vortex</> buffs.

<bold>Passive:</> You take 10% less Magic Damage.

talents.name: Harsh Winds
talents.description:
Enemies hit by <bold>Spirited Vortex</> have 20% reduced Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Spirited Vortex</> damage is increased by 10%

talents.name: Serene Resillience
talents.description:
Your <bold>Serenity</> applies 1% damage reduction for 8 seconds per stack consumed but its healing is reduced by 50%.

<bold>Passive:</> Your <bold>Serenity</> ability has 20% increased Critical Strike chance.

talents.name: Earthbourne
talents.description:
Your <bold>Shatter Earth</> now has 2 charges and each cast of <bold>Shatter Earth</> reduces the cooldown of <bold>Twin Souls: Bulwark</> by 15%.

<bold>Passive:</>
The health and duration of your <bold>Twin Souls: Bulwark</> sibling is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Forbidden Technique
talents.description:
Your <bold>Double Palm Strike</> finisher applies Forbidden Technique to the target for 15 seconds.

<bold>Forbidden Technique</> accumulates 10% of all damage you deal to the target. Once it expires, is removed, or if the enemy dies while it is active -  you are healed for the accumulated amount and the same amount explodes outward to all nearby enemies in an 800 radius.

You can only have one <bold>Forbidden Technique</> active at any time.

<bold>Passive:</>
Your Finishers have 10% increased Critical Strike chance.

lore: Evil destroyed her home and her purpose, now only she remains. Meiko cannot undo what has happened to her people, but she can avenge them. That will be her purpose now.

name: Helena
description:
Despite being weighed down by full plate armor, Helena is always ready to charge into the fray to protect her companions.

Helena is a Melee Tank that uses Builder/Spender Mechanics. She excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

Using Combo Points, Helena can perform powerful attack and generate Toughness.

Toughness is her main resource for mitigating incoming damage and surviving dangerous encounters.
lore: Helena is a stern presence within the Fellowship, maintaining a seasoned warrior’s discipline. She uses both the shield she wields to protect others, and to distance herself becoming too familiar with her companions, lest she suffer the burden of loss again.
